items.description: DocuSign for Salesforce is an eSignature application that lets users/businesses to complete and sign documents electronically, automating workflow and applying automatic updates to existing systems. DocuSign is fully integrated with Salesforce.

Docusign for Outlook is an eSignature application that is fully integrated with Outlook. With this application, users will be able to electronically sign documents sent to their email, and/or assign people to sign the documents within their contacts.

DocuSign for Microsoft is an eSignature application that is integrated with Microsoft Word. The application lets users to review and send documents for signature directly from the MS Office applications that they are using. The recipients are then able to sign the documents electronically using DocuSign.

Zuora is an online company that provides services to businesses who want to sell their products/services via subscription. This application is integrated with DocuSign to enable its customers to electronically sign their documents.

Contract Guardian integrated with DocuSign is a service offered by Contract Guardian that allows customers to sign documents electronically. Customers are also able to add more signers to the documents.

Centrify is a Saas company that provides solutions for unifying identity management across cloud, mobile and data center IT environments. Docusign is integrated with Centrify to allow customers to sign on Centrify's website.
Aplifi is a technology and service provider for the life and annuity industry. Aplifi integrates DocuSign into their applications to enable their customers to electronically sign documents.

Akcelerant is a web application that focuses its development to provide services to the financial industry. The DocuSign Akcelerant Integration allows customers to transfer lending documents to distribute for eSignature.

Smartsheet is a SaaS company that offers a businesses collaboration and work management tool. The Smartsheet and DocuSign integration will enable users to electronically sign documents such as contracts.

eSignature Gateway leverages Amazon S3, Clockwork SMS, DocuSign, Google Storage and Twillio APIs to give users document sign functionality regardless of the email client used. In addition, eSignature implements electronic storage, data analytics and workflow capabilities.

Weever Apps offers leading technology that enables marketers and corporations to launch HTML5 mobile web apps, where one app deploys across all popular touch phones and tablets at a fraction of the cost and delivery time when compared to traditional native mobile app solutions. Weever Apps Phone and Tablet Apps integrate DocuSign Esignatures with many different verticals including Financial Services, Insurance, Medical and others.

Enterprise Rideshare specializes in providing customized vanpool programs and commuter services for individuals and companies across the country. Enterprise Rideshare, a Division of Enterprise Rent-A-Car, was founded in 1994 and has become a national leader in servicing both individual vanpool groups and large employer work sites. The enterpriserideshare.com is a online platform for the Rideshare program. enterpriserideshare.com provides the unified view of the rideshare offering from Enterprise. enterpriserideshare.com enables to customer to search and apply for a vanpool from any given location within the US. enterpriserideshare.com also offers the seamless ability to signup and complete the agreement formalities via an online process.

Skilled Athlete provides mobile tools for fitness studios. We want to help studios treat every customer like it's their first customer. As a gym owner, managing a mountain of paper waivers and contracts is tedious and provides ample opportunity for errors. Moving member waivers and contracts to digital PDFs and allowing clients to sign via their iPhone saves time, money, and paper.

Sign virtually any email attachment with DocuSign Ink. The DocuSign Ink Outlook plugin installs indirectly into the Outlook Home tab enabling you to instantly sign and return documents directly from your Outlook email.

The Lobby Sign In Management Application is a product built by DocuSign that helps customers and partners bring their lobbies into the 21st Century. The Lobby Sign In Application helps manage who is in the building, makes sure different people sign in in an appropriate way (Visitors sign an NDA, for example) and tracks all of that inside the Application.

With DocuSign for Google Apps (Gmail, Calendar, Google Docs and many more), an enterprise user of Google Apps can access DocuSign to send envelopes from any application through the MORE link in the upper navigation bar.
Delivery sign off Android application

DocuSign already gives you the option of voiding an Envelope after you've sent it (like recalling an email), but what if you could void an Envelope while on the go, without internet service? With access to the DocuSign API and Twilio, we can grab information about Envelopes (and execute actions) from a phone call!
DocuSign is an online electronic signature service. It is integrated with Box.net, so users can send files to be e-signed with DocuSign from within the Box.net environment.

Drawloop lets you merge and automate document creation. The service increases sales efficiency, improve close rates and increase revenue by allowing sales reps to create dynamic document packages or DDPs (bundle of Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PDF files).
Music Portal a.k.a indotag.com is a portal of music blog posts and provides a concise snapshot of the latest in music blogging.
hasLockers is a cloud service for content locking based on hasOffers API.
Play kenken and kendoku puzzles games online. There are also Google gadgets associated with this.

Jars of Love allows two people to create a shared list of tasks, suggestions or whatevers for their mutual benefit. Participants can interact with their jar either using the website or through sms. Once per week, or on demand, a random suggestion (alternating between users) will be sent to both parties.

American Directions Group is an online company that provides outreach services to the private and public sectors; specializing in survey market research. Some of the research methods used include phone interviewing, political polling, advertising-message testing, studies of public policies, and more.
Bookmarklet to find Flickr photos taken nearby in time and space to any geotagged Flickr photo.
Use a Google Map to find NYC drink specials by neighborhood and day.

A map of contributions to 2006 Massachusetts gubernatorial campaigns. Uses the Google Maps API and data from the Massachusetts Office of Campaign and Political finance. One of the most extensive use of data with layering on Google Maps.
Yellow pages for Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

MapMyRun is an application that allows users to track their fitness activities using the built-in GPS of their mobile phones. Users of this application can save and upload their workout data to their MapMyRun account, where they can see the information in more details. Additionally, if the city is on the map of the application, runners will be able to search for, and compare different running routes.
Android app that lets you discover music bands and artists similar to your favorites. Integrates with Last.fm and YouTube and uses tagclouds to find related artists.
ODP Mashup Server. A Chinese site meant to help you create mashups. The code embeds in your page, while preserving your style.
Use the MyShopping application for Facebook to connect with friends, co-workers, or family on your daily shopping activities.

An Amazon Product API mashup that aggregates products across 80 categories. Every day the product selections are updated to include Amazon's top sellers, most gifted, most wished-for and new releases from each respective category.
Finds related web sites to a given one from within the pool of (previously) popular web sites on delicious.com.

A Virtual Earth ajax client for locating Gym Alliance fitness clubs. Has search, direction control, the table updates when you mouse-over the club pushpins. If you click through to a specific club, it also provides driving directions.

myMeetingTime is a tool for helping people connect across time zones. Leveraging timezone data from IANA (via TimezoneDB) and mashing it up with geo location names from GeoNames, myMeetingTime is displayed in a graphical interface, making it easy to use.
See which states have the biggest differences between students passing their state tests versus the national tests in math and reading. Uses data reported in Time magazine.
Like tinyurl, but for maps. Create a map, add routes or points of interest, and get a short URL to share it or come back to it later.

IronBox is a service that protects data and secures privacy. Their IronBox Express is a web app that secures a user's DropBox account, ensuring file protection for all folder contents. IronBox enables privacy protected file sharing accompanied with notifications upon content usage. IronBox Express also offers customizable themes to match a company's branding.
TodoToday Pro for Teambox is a task list application to show current todo items from the online collaboration and project management tool Teambox
TodoToday for Toodledo is a simple todo list application to show current due and overdue tasks from the online task management tool Toddledo.com.
Agenteimovel.com.br is a Brazilian real estate website offering sale and rental listings as well as property statistics and trends.
Satirical humor site about payday loans. Mashup helps predatory lenders find people who might take out payday loans.
TweetaCelebe lists all the verified celebrities and personalities on Twitter and allows users to track their tweet streams and follow them.
Import of times tracked via mite into the billing tool billomat.
This mashup helps locate safety shelters in India. With Tropical Cyclone Phailin closing in on land many people will be looking to find safety.
View incoming flights into 7 major US cities. Altitude, speed, heading and flight path are all interactively displayed on the map. Be air traffic control.
Add a chatter like button to your internet and intranet web page and allow users to directly like within the web page. Its similar to the Facebook like button.

An ongoing caption competition that selects two photos from a group on Flickr every day to receive dozens of funny captions. Also uses D3/node.js and Bing image search to show a collaborative mind map for brainstorming caption ideas.
Google Maps mashup for those wanting to discover new restaurants in a specific area.
Voice-enabled language translator for mobile devices. It allows two-way real-time communication between two people who cannot speak a common language
InformScan provides a free people search engine that includes public records, emails, US addresses, phone numbers and more.

In a few clicks, adds an official Twitter Button to your WordPress site that you can change to target any hashtag you want. When clicked, it preformats a tweet that includes a bitly link back to your article so that your readers can send your content into Twitter on relevant hashtags - increasing your social traffic.
Displays a real-time photo stream from Twitter on a Google map.
A site specializing in local news and local business listings.
Quickly find campus buildings with this campus map of the University of Texas at Austin.
Create you own winery tour! Mashup of U.S. wineries, winery events, wine festivals, and wine trails. Over 3,200 entries. Includes printable Google directions with full winery contact information.
When you ever need the pronunciation of a word, send the word via SMS to SayIt ☎ at 917.740.1911. You'll receive a call with the pronunciation (if found), and also an optional definition!
This mashup allows Box.net users to securely share files in their Box accounts using WatchDox, a service that allows users to track and control the sharing and use of files.
Interactive map of current and past members of the Iraq Multinational Coalition, current troop count by country, and related links.
Calculates the distance between any 2 cities in the world and creates day routes between landmarks for major cities.

MapEcos is a map of US facilities with information on pollution and improvement efforts. Provides information for 23,000 facilities as well as data aggregated at company, industry, and geographic levels. Data from EPA.
This GMail gadget displays real-time arrival estimates of the Madison Metro at a specified stop.
Searchable map of the University of South Florida (USF) campus.
Google map mashup with cards from the World of Warcraft card game. Browse around the screen, zoom in, and explore all the Heroes of Azeroth cards.

Everyone knows texting and driving is dangerous, yet when a text message comes in, it's difficult not to respond. AT&T DriveMode is a free* app that silences incoming text message alerts so you can stay focused while driving. The AT&T DriveMode iOS App for iPhone uses the In-App Messaging API to send auto replies on behalf of the driver indicating the driver is on the road and unavailable to text. The AT&T Webhooks Notifications API provides push notifications for the AT&T DriveMode iOS App. *Data and messaging rates apply
Geo presents various information from the World Bank, including projects, data, news, and center location.

View tweets on Google Earth. This Google Earth plug-in allows you to navigate and explore geographic data on a 3D globe using a web browser. The plug-in is also used on Earth view in Google Maps. If you want to embed the Google Earth plug-in on your website, visit the Google Earth API site to learn more.

Printsgram provides printable PDF files from your Instagram photos, with several different layout templates. PDF files are created on standart international paper sizes, so you can print them with your printer or go to a local print store for larger prints.
Real time Google maps of current parking availability in the San Francisco Bay Area.
Washington DC city and transit guide Google Maps mashup. Metro Links also combines blog postings from Window Shopper, Free Ride and Top Stops.
Mashup of Google Maps and Rocky Mountain venture capital investments
A quick and easy way to find movies, watch trailers and share with friends!
We all have people in our lives we'd like to talk to more often. Stay In Touch is a simple app that helps you prioritize and stay connected to the family and friends you care about.
Provides an overview of travel highlights around the world using interactive maps with destinations such as cities, beaches, national parks and cultural sites.
5 planes taking off one after the other from the same runway in Atlanta. Click on the numbered markers to see the sequence. Not sure if they are same or different.
Enthusem is a service that allows users to send physical greeting cards online. Through its integration with Box.net, users can send cards containing content from their Box.net files.
Takes all YouTube videos posted to any public Facebook page, group or profile and plays them as a continuous stream.
This gadget grabs the Yahoo weather feed for any US zip code or international country code, and updates an object to display the current weather in Second Life.

A selection of independently developed add-in buttons that make Thrutu on Android even more useful. The following buttons are currently available. There are plenty more planned... - Barcode reader - Recommend installed application - Browse to My WebPage - Share browser bookmark - Share BBC News article **NEW** Although the Button Collection is currently only available on Android, most buttons can happily be used when in a Thrutu call with someone using the iPhone version of Thrutu. - Barcode reader - Recommend installed application - Browse to My WebPage - Share browser bookmark - Share BBC News article
The Kiva plugin for Wordpress lets people raise the visibility of Kiva by displaying loans in the fundraising stage with a link donate.
A new way of discovering music artist and albums by reading tumblr reviews about them and browsing recomendations.
Real-time visualizations of the stream of information flowing into Flickr. View photos, tags or buddy icons as they are active on the site.
iBlueSky is a mind mapping application for the iPhone, and this mashup allows users to save mind maps from iBlueSky directly to their Box.net accounts.
Add photos search from Flickr photos in your website and display them.
Save and share your favorite restaurants, or use the tag cloud to see others favorites. In Italian.
Ringostrack.com is a website to find and listen online to soundtracks. Amazon integration provides details.
Rate basketball dunk video clips from YouTube.
Latest product information aggregated from Buy.com and Amazon.com. Updated through RSS Syndication.
Interactive Guide to the Ports and Mooring Places of the Upper Adriatic.
MapLib.net is a free service that allows users to upload pictures that may be as large as 6000 by 6000 and create their own custom Google maps.

Make a Minyan allows members of a synagogue to be notified when short of the 10 men necessary to pray. Users subscribe to a minyan and can receive notifications via text message, email, or phone call. They can then respond if they are coming and say if they are bringing others.
Browse landmarks and other locations in London with this application that combines Google Earth, Google Maps and Wikipedia.

Doctor Who - unlike Star Trek which always used the same rock for its location filming - was surprisingly varied in its choice of quarries. This mashup shows where they are all and includes a kml for Google Earth.
A website which provides deal tracking and price analysis for outdoor gear. Offers a price history and price comparison tool, as well as email and text alerts.
CareerVote is a social rating, review and tagging mashup that allows people to find and share information about the work environment at different companies.
Location based job search. Helping locals find local jobs by plotting jobs on Google Maps. The easiest way to find a job near you.
Iran Election Protest Tweets from Middle East, Europe, Eastern and Western United States
loc.alize.us displays a massive amount of photos on a highly interactive world map. Explore photos from everyones places, selected topics or people you know.

Tugar helps you find good restaurants, bars, and even a place to rent or buy in Chile. There's some cool features such as GeoRSS, which means you can subscribe to a specified area, and Tugar will keep you updated whenever something good comes up.

TapTravel is a mobile application that allows users to search for and book for flights. TapTravel is available in all major mobile platforms. The Allmyles API has been integrated into this application.
Mapping community site that lets users create and save maps consisting of waypoints and routes.
Play free online flash games; sports, physics, dress up, puzzle, action, arcade, multiplayer, shooting, girl, strategy games and more. Gametator.com also produces its own exclusive games.
Whooligan is a global soccer, lifestyle and multimedia brand created and marketed by user-generated content.

TweetMinus is a browser extension that notifies you when people stop following you on Twitter. No more wondering if people are unfollowing you. Now you will know. TweetMinus displays your results on Twitter.com, so that you don't have to go to another site.
BART station maps, schedules, timetables, and other details in a convenient Google Map
Map Tunneller allows users to view the direct antipode of a given location. Users can zoom and pan around on the top map and view the selected location's antipode on the bottom map.

Loqi.me allows mobile users to send an emergency GPS beacon to a real-time map. Crises responders can view all of the help requests on the webpage, along with hospitals and fire stations, real-time 911 calls related to natural disasters. Ground teams can easily use Loqi.me on their mobile phones and it supports subscription to group messages via SMS, AIM, Jabber and Twitter. No application installation is required.
iLoveInns is a Bed and Breakfast locator. Search by location or by a region to drill down. It also has gift certificates, a shopping cart, my favorites and other features.
This is a visual amazon gift explorer. It uses amazons most-wished rss feeds and similarity data from the Amazon API to suggest gifts.

WhatWine is a mobile application that acts as a personal sommelier to those that love to pair wine with their meal. This application helps customers to quickly choose an appropriate type of wine to pair with their meal, turning even the layman into a wine expert.
Java API wrapper library for Safe Creative copyright registry service.
An efficient Captcha Bypass Service.
See casinos and other places to legally play live poker on a map. Find the closest rooms sorted by distance, get driving directions and the casino web site.
A description box which offers the ability to show a picture of a city and, by clicking on Show map, a google map with its geolocalization.
Droidin is first ever LinkedIn app on Android platform. After 2 years and 3 incarnations it is entirely LinkedIn API based and continues be the most full featured LinkedIn app on the Android market
The DC stands for DonorsChoose (not District of Columbia). This site lets you sign up for alerts for when classrooms in your interest area need donations.
Multi-click real-time polls for real fans and real cynics
The top 25 American cities with population greater than 250,000 ranked by percentage of bachelor degree holders among residents 25 years and older.
mygoogleplus.com uses Google+ API to transform user profile into a Facebook style timeline.
Enter an artist name and get videos, discography, bio, torrents and related artists
A mapping tool for property managers that they can add to their site.
Create an advanced photo calendar with your Flickr photos. It is easy to use, and there are many templates to choose from.

Inflooenz is a music discovery tool based on the concept of influences. It allows the user to get introduced to unknown musicians through their favorite ones in a friendly way. Inflooenz creates a playlist with the very best of each influencer to showcase their work and populates other relevant information for a friendly first approach. Its main difference against other recommendation engines is that 'influence' is a wider concept than similarity: while still related to a starting point (the favorite artist), the user can come up with new music that it's not 'more of the same'.
Browse through trees of the world, categorized by country. When you click a tree link, photos are retrieved from Flickr and displayed.
Shopping comparison search engine built using the PriceSpin XML Shopping Comparison API.
The FlickrSpy is back. Check out the new 2008 FlickrSpy and watch whats uploaded right now at flickr.

SocketBot builds web applications using Node.js and Angluar JS. SocketBot also works with JavaScript, HTTP, and CSS for front-end development. A project they have developed is Stateship which allows users to find their national, state, and local government representatives.
This mashup combines job listings from Indeed with company reviews from Glassdoor for job searches within the data science.
A fun game to play with your friends: we randomly choose one of your Instagram photos, they choose the most appropriate song for it.

OSCity (Open Source City) brings the Dutch spatial planning together with the newest information technology. By directly searching, visualizing and combining spatial data everybody is invited - from citizen, entrepreneur, designer and civil servant - to gain insight into everything that is spatial.
PhoneCo.in enables anyone with a cell phone to send and receive bitcoins. Simple, mobile, point-of-sale bitcoin transactions are as easy as sending a text message.
Track FedEx packages--with per-segment CO2 estimates.
Real-time schedules and rider alerts from Metro Transit on iPhone, Android, and Windows Mobile devices
Takes addresses submitted with a Formstack form and displays the locations on a Google Maps map.
Aanbieding is the leading discount app in The Netherlands.

Yer not still usin' them google maps arr ye? Blasted landlubber... Yarr, Pirate Maps is the greatest invenshun since iBones. It's just like usin' real google maps, but better - 'cos everythin' is all piratey and mappy.

Starbucks customers who use the free Wi-Fi at more than 6,800 U.S. company-operated stores are greeted with the Starbucks Digital Network (SDN), an exclusive content network curated by the company and designed to enhance the customerâ€™s in-store experience. DonorsChoose.org is prominently featured in the My Neighborhood section of the SDN. When Starbucks customers click the DonorsChoose.org tile in the SDN, our API's projects near me functionality shows the customer the closest classroom projects to their location!
Winner of the Sunlight Foundation Mashup Congress Contest. Get more insight into the truth of campaign finance with this interactive network maps of state level political contribution data.

CheckinSpy lets you view the places that you and your friends have checked in, using Google Street View. You can look at recent checkins that you or your friends have posted, or search for a specific friend.
Used by a private flying club, this system uses Twilio so that users can book the plane using their phone, and recieve notifications to booking changes through SMS

Audibase is an audio social network. With this application available on iTunes, users can upload, comment, and share in an online community. The app aims to be particularly useful for journalists, coaches, and interviewers because it records until 2 hours of audio material.
A community mashup where parents can create, review, tag, and map fun places to take their family.

Access your personal phone book from any phone with a simple phone call or from a computer. A lost, stolen, uncharged or damaged cell phone doesn't mean you've lost access to your contacts. As a Bevoz member you have backup access from any phone worldwide. Simply dial the Bevoz access number and use your personalized secure PIN to access your account contacts.

Wikipedia-roll is a global and dynamic version of articles from Wikipedia. Gives access to a global vision of a subject through the definition and items of the article in Wikipedia. Then by mashup serendipity, it discovers a lot of things.
Use this PostRank Google Reader extension to bring PostRank filtering into Google Reader. View rankings for each feed and custom tweak your settings.

Audience Partners is an enterprise advertising management company that focuses on on healthcare, politics and public affairs. With the Audience Partners platform, customers will be able to micro-target different messages to different audience segments in order to increase engagement and return on their advertisement.
Penny Parrot is an Amazon price trackef of products on Amazon. Its modern and mobile-friendly charts let you see the exact price at any moment. You can subscribe for price drop alerts via email.
Mashing up the Google Feed API and Windows Live Search for isfeed: access to RSS files, this provides a river of news reading experience for recent posts around any keyword.
Virtual Earth tour of New York City using Google Earth and Mapfish.
Find the best place to hold a meeting for attendees by entering postcodes. The COG tool will then work out the centre for the meeting.
Discover all the artists playing at thse 2013 Austin City Limits Music Festival taking place on October 4-6 & 11-13 in Austin, TX with ACL.fm, the unofficial radio app for ACL Fest.

Prototype of the technology to create a set of visualization widgets that make use of eGovPDX's City Council Connect API. Will be developing further to create a vote count widgets for desktop and blog.
Japanese talents (actor, actress, models) directory service.
Predict and Share the outcome of 2012 US Presidential Elections
Detailed Spanish real estate listings.
A sortable, filterable, editable list of the best high schools in America, driven by the Factual Web Apps API.
The New York City streets are full of interesting and potentially useful things that have been thrown out. If you see something good, snap a pic, send to GarbageScout where others can go and get it.
Property search engine for Spain of property data.
A handful of examples for using CartoDB API data to develop advanced HTML5 maps.
FoxyMap is a Google Gadget which allows you to monitor the locations of speed traps. Those locations are set via mobile tagging by the users of the mobile application FoxyTag.
Online running log service with local search and sharing using Google maps. Running log has nice graphing features.

iTavli by iSmart Solutions is a backgammon game mashup. The objective of each game is to transfer the chips (or checkers) from the base area to the collecting area. Each game has different rules that the players need to follow.
Twitter & SMS custom social media dashboard for all things related to TwilioCon 2012.

Using information gathered from newspapers, planning board agendas and other sources, plots of new retail developments of several national retailers such as Wal-Mart, Target, and Kohls using a Google Maps interface.
This Google Maps mashup shows countries through which the equator passes.
TapGuest is a digital waitlist application for iPad and mobile phones that uses Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.
Good interactive map of the Washington DC Metrorail.
Best photos of supercars in Russia on Google Maps.
Displays Amtrak rail routes and stations on Google Maps.
Travel mashup for business travellers - people who want to see all essential data about a particular city will find this site useful.
Use email to send SMS from your Nexmo account.
Search for city properties and view listings via Google Maps.
Dual maps let you display two maps side-by-side for a single location. Use the dual map to combine the features of Google Maps and Microsoft Virtual Earth Maps within one embeddable control.

Setup wish lists of items you'd like to purchase, customize them with pictures and themes. Give them a password or leave them public and open them up for commenting. OS X users can use a dashboard widget to make a wishlist, and share it when its ready.
This tool can find the distance between full UK postcodes and display the route on a map.

WebServicesPros provide automation between Americommerce shopping cart and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems through the use of AC API Web Services and different ERP and Accounting Softwares. The WebServicesPros Desktop application serves as an intermediary application to bridge the two systems as well as provide additional features to both ends when they are not present. The configurable and customized solutions allow several different shopping carts or even different cart providers to integrate while assisting the back office by making the process efficient and seamless from the accounting and fulfillment point of view.
Use this comprehensive index from HDTV Magazine to find television stations broadcasting in HDTV for all major US markets. Map gives details by station including power information.
A Wordpress plugin that pushes updates to Taglets.org when you publish a post.
Monitors Rhapsody for tracks played and automatically submits them to a users Last.fm profile.
An iTunes-clone for the browser. Built on the SoundCloud API, jQuery and Google App Engine.

XNSPY can be used as a parental or employee phone monitoring solution to determine a phone user's GPS location as well as additional phone data. The app enables one to monitor SMS, WhatsApp, Viber, Line, Skype, iMessage, and other IM chats automatically. XNSPY can monitor outgoing and incoming calls, record phone calls, receive instant 24/7 alerts, and more.
Geospeaker is a web application providing a virtual loudspeaker to communicate with people around you
Search for, pinpoint, and review speed traps located anywhere on the planet. The information shared by its members is placed into a database and can be viewed by anyone.
An example use of the Wookmark API to show popular images as a screensaver (with HTML5 fullscreen support). It uses jQuery and the source code is fully documented.

The goal of Zoomap is to populate maps with user images. Add any image on any place in the world and leave a message in a text bubble. Everything on the map can be viewed by other users, the images can be reused and you can send the location by email.
Sportmeets connects online users who love sports so that they can meet, organize their teams and events and compete offline.
Get notified by SMS when someone fills in your Wordpress online contact form. Also works with Contact Form 7.
GeoChirp helps you search real time for people Twittering for specific things in a specific area. Translate tweets in any language. You can even search Twitter globally for anything.
See locations of the venues for the 2006 events with good links to details from the official Olympics site. From Remo Madella.

Vertical search for US Colleges and Universities. The site includes in-depth information such as tuition cost and retention information on over seven-thousand schools. Check out a birds-eye view of the colleges.
Travel site for people who do not always follow the crowds. Combines directions with points of interest.
Spookiest places around the world as identified by Forbes.
CycleTrader.com leverages the Uship API to provide users with bulk and large item shipping costs.
Best movies in theaters, coming soon or on dvd. Search movies, find movie times for theaters.
Rules of thumb in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year contains an interesting rule of thumb from business, real estate, finance, fashion, sports, and more.

Smssafar is an online booking company that provides customer services tailored to unique traveling needs. Some of these services include finding flights, booking hotels, and pairing users with relevant tour packages. Routes booked through Smssafar are in India only.
Attractions in Dublin Ireland mapped on a Google Map.

Subscribe to your Delicious TV feed and program your Boxe TV from delicous. Bookmark videos, genre listings, playlists, other peoples Delicious TV listings, etc. to delicious, then view them in Boxee.
Visual deal-hunting using the hotukdeals.com API. The API offers a way to tap into deals ranked by its 200,000 UK members.
FlickTickr allows you to create your own scrolling ticker for your favorite Flickr feeds. It takes only two steps to create a ticker.
Notify member agents of new customers that are seeking real estate agents in their area. Full buyer/seller details are provided over the phone for deciding whether to work with the prospect.
Listen to Pandora online radio on your iGoogle page.
FIFA, World Cup Soccer 2006 map. Latest team news via Yahoo FIFA 2006 World Cup Soccer RSS feeds and Goolge News feeds.
Customized Google News for your locality. Set the location and source and add some keywords if needed, you will what is happening around you.
A free frequent-flyer mileage and point tracking site on the internet focused solely on tracking and managing rewards. Tools and services to make managing and redeeming miles and points easier.
Driving Evals collects, stores and communicates student and instructor evaluations for High Performance Driving Events. It pulls and pushes student/instructor data from MotorsportReg.com.
Queries the Amazon Products API for book information and then generates APA and MLA format citations for your sources cited page for when you write papers.
Typographic news explorer using a doodled line as an interface.

Sunday Morning Rides is an interactive community portal for motorcycle riders to access, explore, plan, and share motorcycle tracks via a ride mapping system that combines GPS, geographic information systems, database, and Google mapping technologies.

ShoesNBags is the first, native iPhone app for Zappos catalog searching. It is easy to use and allows users to browse, search and buy products from Zappos.com. It works on all iOS devices and it requires Internet connectivity.
Goggles is a very fun and creative flight simulator built on top of Google Maps. Pick from one of five cities and go. Change altitude and direction using the arrow keys.

SoundsGud is an entertainment and advertising company that creates content for Mobile Operators, Vendors, CRBT Promoters, and more. SoundsGud focuses mostly on sound conversion, to attract their clients customers with advertisement.
Easy-to-use web app that lets a user share and discuss highlighted passages from books they are reading on their Amazon Kindle or Kindle app utilizing the Goodreads and Twitter APIs.

A free PDF file sharing site where you can upload/download/share PDF collections in private or in public, or read the PDF online using a built-in PDF reader. Doocu is using Amazon EC2 and S3 for storage and database.
Real-time polling mashup. People can ask questions and watch the answers come in real-time, with geographic locations.
